chunks: - [Buildkite agents](https://buildkite.com/docs/agent) hosted by Buildkite that run on Windows Server 2022 in ephemeral virtual machines.

- Configured as part of a _Buildkite hosted queue_, where the machine type is Windows, with a particular [size](https://buildkite.com/docs/agent/buildkite-hosted/windows#sizes) to efficiently manage jobs with varying requirements.

Windows hosted agents are currently in private preview and must be enabled for your Buildkite organization. To request access, contact the Buildkite Support team at [support@buildkite.com](mailto:support@buildkite.com).
- How to configure Windows hosted agents in [Create a Buildkite hosted queue](https://buildkite.com/docs/agent/queues/managing#create-a-buildkite-hosted-queue).

- The [concurrency](https://buildkite.com/docs/agent/buildkite-hosted/windows#concurrency), [security](https://buildkite.com/docs/agent/buildkite-hosted/windows#security), and [current limitations](https://buildkite.com/docs/agent/buildkite-hosted/windows#current-limitations) of Windows hosted agents.
Windows hosted agents support the AMD64 architecture in four instance shapes:

Windows hosted agents use a fixed, Buildkite-managed Windows Server 2022 base image. Windows hosted queues don't support the base image configuration available for [Linux](https://buildkite.com/docs/agent/buildkite-hosted/linux#agent-images) and [macOS](https://buildkite.com/docs/agent/buildkite-hosted/macos#macos-instance-software-support) hosted queues. A Windows hosted queue's settings page doesn't display a **Base Image** tab.
Windows hosted agents can operate concurrently when running your Buildkite pipeline jobs.

The number of Windows hosted agents that can process jobs concurrently depends on the Windows vCPU concurrency allocated to your organization and the [instance shape](https://buildkite.com/docs/agent/buildkite-hosted/windows#sizes) configured for the queue.
Each Windows job runs in an isolated virtual machine that Buildkite destroys, together with its data, after the job completes.
Windows hosted agents don't currently support:

- Custom base images
- [Cache volumes](https://buildkite.com/docs/agent/buildkite-hosted/cache-volumes)
- [Terminal access](https://buildkite.com/docs/agent/buildkite-hosted/terminal-access) using SSH
- [Desktop access](https://buildkite.com/docs/agent/buildkite-hosted/desktop-access) using VNC or Remote Desktop
- ARM64 architecture
- Windows Server 2025
- Selecting a Windows shell in the queue settings
- Selecting or managing the Buildkite agent version
- Windows jobs through the [GitHub Actions compatibility feature](https://buildkite.com/docs/pipelines/migration/run-github-actions-workflows)
